title: Pipedrive MCP for ChatGPT - Knowledge Base | Pipedrive
snippet:
**Note:** ChatGPT can only access data and perform actions that your Pipedrive user account is authorized to access. Permissions are inherited from your existing Pipedrive role and visibility settings. You **must** have a Pro, Business, Enterprise or Edu ChatGPT plan to connect the Pipedrive MCP.
You can connect the Pipedrive MCP server to ChatGPT to allow your AI assistant to securely access and interact with your Pipedrive data.
---
## Before you begin
Make sure that you have permission to install apps in your Pipedrive account and that** developer mode** is enabled in ChatGPT.
To enable **developer mode** in ChatGPT, open **”Security and login”**. Then, scroll down to **”Developer mode”**.

## Create the Pipedrive MCP app
Once developer mode is enabled, go to **”Plugins”** on the left-hand side of the screen and click ****”+”**** to create a new plugin.
![](https://kb-cms.pipedriveassets.com/mcp%20chatgpt%204.png)
Enter Pipedrive MCP as the app name and in the **”Connection”** field enter [https://mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp](https://mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp). Then, click **”Create”**.
![](https://kb-cms.pipedriveassets.com/mcp%20chatgpt%205-1.png)
After creating the app, you’ll be redirected to Pipedrive to complete the installation.
![](https://kb-cms.pipedriveassets.com/mcp%20chatgpt%206-1.png)

## Use Pipedrive MCP in ChatGPT
Before starting your conversation, add the plugin **”Pipedrive MCP”** to the conversation.
![](https://kb-cms.pipedriveassets.com/mcp%20chatgpt%208-1.png)
Your AI assistant can now access Pipedrive data and perform supported actions based on the permissions granted to your account.

title: Pipedrive MCP tools - Knowledge Base | Pipedrive
snippet:
In MCP, **tools** are the actions that an AI assistant can perform in Pipedrive. Each tool is designed for a specific task, such as creating a deal, retrieving a contact's details or updating an activity.
When an AI assistant connects to Pipedrive through MCP, it can use these tools to access information and perform actions on your behalf, based on the permissions you grant.
Tool names follow a consistent naming pattern:
| getX (plural) | Fetch a list |
|---|---|
| getX (singular) | Fetch one specific record |
| addX | Create a new record |
| updateX | Edit an existing record |
| searchX | Find records by keyword or criteria |

Fetch a list of deals | "Show me all open deals in my pipeline" |
| getDeal | Fetch one specific deal | "Get details of the Acme deal" |
| addDeal | Create a new deal | "Create a deal for this new prospect" |
| updateDeal | Edit an existing deal | "Move this deal to the next stage" or "Update the value" |
| searchDeals | Search deals by keyword | "find all deals mentioning *enterprise*" |

title: Pipedrive MCP Server | Connect Claude & ChatGPT to Your CRM
snippet:
Empower AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude to securely and reliably work with your Pipedrive data. Find deals, update records, get insights, move opportunities through your pipeline and automate workflows, all from your AI assistant.
Pipedrive is an official connector in Claude and ChatGPT. Find it in the connector directory and connect your account. No manual server setup required.
Trusted by 100,000+ companies in 179 countries
## How the Pipedrive MCP server works
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that lets AI assistants securely connect to external tools and data sources. With Pipedrive MCP, your AI assistant can securely access and act on your CRM data using natural language.
**Step 1: Connect securely**
Connect your AI assistant to Pipedrive in minutes via a secure OAuth login. No coding, APIs, middleware or developer support required.
**Step 2: Ask your AI to act**
Simply tell ChatGPT or Claude what you want to do, using plain language directly from its input box.
**Step 3: Get instant results**
Your AI assistant can find information, update records, create activities and automate workflows using live Pipedrive data.

MCP gives your AI assistant access to Pipedrive. Skills are ready-made instructions that show Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools how to handle everyday sales tasks, using your live Pipedrive data. Skills handle the busywork behind a good sales week: where to focus, what’s slipping and whether you’re on track. Every rep starts each day knowing what matters, not digging for it.

You stay in control.
An official, reliable and fully supported connection built and maintained by Pipedrive.

##### Fast and easy setup
Connect in minutes through secure OAuth. No coding, no API development, no developer required.
